//: Copy to server/api/appsettings.Production.json and fill the CHANGE_ME values. The DB connection is injected by docker-compose from the .env POSTGRES_* values — not here.

Identity.//EncryptionKey: A stable random secret: `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it constant or all issued tokens/cookies break.
Identity.//urls: OIDC issuer + client base. For the one-box stack these are the nginx address (https). If you host on a real domain, put that here (and in the client template) and restart.

//Reporting: Folders the engine scans for runtime plugins (bind-mounted volume). Drop your plugin bundle into server/plugins/<id>/.
//PathBase: The whole API is mounted under /api behind the proxy; UsePathBase strips it. Leave as /api.
